environments.name: shop - prod
environments.description: Production. Every run needs an approval by someone other than the person who started it.

approval.instructions: Check the change, the release notes and the acceptance result. You cannot approve a run you started yourself.

environments.name: shop - prod - Data
environments.description: Production databases: two approvals, one of them by a database administrator.

approval.instructions: A database administrator reviews the migration script; a production approver reviews the release.

environments.name: shop - prod - Diagnostics
environments.policyExemption: Runs only read-only diagnostics with a reader service connection that has its own checks; a deployment here cannot change production.
